result.stdout:
mockmcp — declarative mocking for MCP servers, tools, and CLIs.

Usage:
  mockmcp init [server|proxy|cli|strict|record] [path]
                                           Scaffold an example fixture.
  mockmcp serve <fixture.json> [--mode strict|lenient|passthrough]
                                           Run the replacement MCP server (stdio).
  mockmcp replay <cassette.jsonl>          Replay a recorded cassette as a mock server.
  mockmcp proxy <proxy-config.json> [--record <cassette>]
                                           Run the transparent interposing proxy (stdio).
  mockmcp record <proxy-config.json> --cassette <path>
                                           Proxy the real server and record calls + results.
  mockmcp convert <cassette.jsonl> <out.json> [--cli]
                                           Convert a cassette into a replayable fixture.
  mockmcp make-shims <cli.json> <out-dir> [--record <cassette>]
                                           Generate PATH shims for CLI mocking / recording.
  mockmcp assert <log.jsonl> [checks...]   Assert over a JSONL call log.

Mock modes (serve):
  strict        Calls must occur in the configured order and arguments.
  lenient       Any order; expectations may be optional; unknown calls fail.
  passthrough   Unknown calls fall back to the tool default.
  After a strict/lenient run, the harness calls the 'mockmcp_finalize'
  tool to verify no required expectation was missed.

Environment:
  MOCKMCP_LOG        JSONL request log path (serve/proxy).
  MOCKMCP_MODE       Mock mode (strict|lenient|passthrough) for serve.
  MOCKMCP_UNEXPECTED "error" => unexpected call throws a JSON-RPC error.
  MOCKMCP_REPLAY     Cassette path to replay (serve).
  MOCKMCP_RECORD     Cassette path to record (proxy).
  MOCKMCP_STRICT     "1" => unknown tool returns a JSON-RPC error (serve).

Assert checks:
  --tool-called NAME            --tool-not-called NAME
  --call-count NAME=N           --tool-called-with NAME=JSON
  --command-called N
[truncated]
